summary.text: Almaria Baker is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Jared Bauman (R).
She is a teacher and early childhood business owner who also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Baker was born in Cadiz, Kentucky, and Ballotpedia lists degrees from the University of Louisville (2001 and 2003) and the University of the Cumberlands (2013).
In a Ballotpedia survey she described a career as a Jefferson County Public Schools teacher, small business owner (Early Learning Foundation), and adjunct professor at Campbellsville University.

She listed community involvement as a member of Delta Sigma Theta, a former NAACP executive board member, a member of the Jefferson County Teachers Association, and an executive board member of the Louisville Democratic Party.
Baker did not win the 2018 Democratic primary for Louisville Metro Council District 15 and the 2022 Democratic primary for this House seat.
She was the Democratic nominee in 2024 and received 41.4% of the vote to Bauman's 58.6%.
In the survey she named education, including opposition to charter schools, regulation of chemical companies, and support for abortion rights as her key messages.
